items.name: TombstoneView
items.summary: A lightweight, cloneable view over a single tombstone (`Remove` action) row.

methods.name: data_change
methods.summary: Returns whether removing this file represents a data change (vs. a compaction-style rewrite).

methods.name: deletion_timestamp
methods.summary: Returns the deletion timestamp (milliseconds since epoch), if recorded.

methods.name: path
methods.summary: Returns the file path with URL decoding applied.

methods.name: size
methods.summary: Returns the size of the removed file in bytes, if recorded.
